titel: The Man Who Sold the Eiffel Tower

einstellungen.text: In 1925, a man sold the Eiffel Tower. Then he came back to sell it again.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: The Eiffel Tower in Paris in 1925 at dusk, light rain, Parisians with umbrellas and period clothing on the street below, low angle
einstellungen.video_prompt: slow push in towards the tower, rain falling

einstellungen.text: His name was Victor Lustig, a con man with a dozen fake names.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: A dramatized 1920s con man in a tailored three-piece suit and fedora, confident smirk, smoky Paris cafe, film noir lighting, clearly a staged cinematic reenactment
einstellungen.video_prompt: he adjusts his hat and smiles subtly

einstellungen.text: He read in a Paris newspaper that the tower was expensive to repair.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: Close-up of hands holding a 1920s French newspaper at a cafe table, coffee cup, morning light, no readable text

einstellungen.text: So he posed as a government official and invited scrap-metal dealers to a luxury hotel.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: Grand 1920s Paris luxury hotel salon, chandeliers, businessmen in suits arriving, warm golden light
einstellungen.video_prompt: slow pan across the room as men take their seats

einstellungen.text: His story: the tower will be torn down. It's a secret. Make me an offer.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot of the con man leaning across a polished table speaking quietly to a nervous businessman, cigarette smoke, tension

einstellungen.text: One dealer, André Poisson, paid. Lustig took the money and fled to Vienna.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: A leather briefcase full of 1920s French banknotes on a train seat, steam train compartment, motion blur outside the window
einstellungen.video_prompt: the train rocks gently, landscape rushes past

einstellungen.text: Poisson was too embarrassed to tell the police.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: A middle-aged 1920s businessman sitting alone in a dim office, head in his hands, rain on the window

einstellungen.text: So a month later, Lustig came back to Paris and tried the exact same trick.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: The con man stepping off a train at a busy 1920s Paris station, steam, confident walk, cinematic wide shot
einstellungen.video_prompt: he walks toward camera through the steam

einstellungen.text: This time, the buyer went to the police, and Lustig escaped to America.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: A 1920s ocean liner leaving a foggy harbor at night, lights glowing, dramatic sky
einstellungen.video_prompt: the ship slowly pulls away into the fog

einstellungen.text: And the Eiffel Tower? Still standing. Still not for sale. Probably.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: The Eiffel Tower today at golden hour seen from the Trocadero, vibrant and majestic
einstellungen.video_prompt: slow pull back revealing the tower
